recipes.name: Cacio e Pepe
steps: Boil pasta in heavily salted water. Reserve pasta water.
Mix finely grated Pecorino or Parmesan with abundant black pepper.
Create emulsion with hot pasta water.
Toss pasta vigorously until glossy.

recipes.name: Spaghetti Carbonara
steps: Render guanciale or pancetta until crisp.
Cook pasta al dente.
Whisk eggs with grated Pecorino and pepper.
Toss hot pasta with fat, then off heat with egg mixture and pasta water. Never scramble.

recipes.name: Risotto ai Funghi
steps: Sauté onion in butter. Add mushrooms until golden. Deglaze with wine.
Toast Arborio rice. Add hot stock ladle by ladle while stirring.
Finish with cold butter and Parmesan (mantecatura). Rest 1 minute.

recipes.name: Aglio e Olio
steps: Cook spaghetti. Gently fry sliced garlic in olive oil until golden.
Add chili. Toss with pasta, pasta water and parsley.

recipes.name: Osso Buco
steps: Dust and brown shanks. Sauté soffritto. Deglaze with wine.
Add tomato and stock. Braise covered 2 hours.
Serve with gremolata.

recipes.name: Margherita Pizza
steps: Mix dough, knead, bulk ferment. Divide and proof.
Stretch, top with crushed tomato, mozzarella, olive oil.
Bake at highest temperature. Finish with basil.

recipes.name: Lasagna Bolognese
steps: Make ragù with soffritto, meat, tomato, milk.
Make béchamel.
Layer pasta, ragù, béchamel, cheese. Bake until bubbling.

recipes.name: Pesto Genovese
steps: Pound or blend basil, garlic, cheese with olive oil.
Season. Toss with pasta.

recipes.name: Eggplant Parmesan
steps: Salt eggplant, bread and fry or bake.
Layer with tomato sauce and mozzarella.
Bake until golden.

recipes.name: Tiramisu
steps: Whip yolks with sugar, fold in mascarpone.
Dip ladyfingers in strong coffee.
Layer cream and biscuits. Dust cocoa. Chill.

recipes.name: Spaghetti Bolognese
steps: Sauté soffritto. Brown beef.
Add wine, tomato, milk, bay. Simmer long.
Toss with pasta.

recipes.name: Gnocchi Sage Butter
steps: Boil and rice potatoes. Mix with flour and egg.
Roll and cut. Boil until they float.
Toss in sage butter.

recipes.name: Chicken Cacciatore
steps: Brown chicken. Sauté onion and pepper.
Add garlic, tomato, wine, oregano.
Simmer until tender.

recipes.name: Ribollita
steps: Sauté soffritto. Add beans, tomato, kale.
Simmer. Stir in day-old bread.
Rest and reheat.

recipes.name: Focaccia
steps: Make soft dough with olive oil.
Proof, dimple, top with oil, salt, rosemary.
Bake until golden.

recipes.name: Saltimbocca
steps: Pound cutlets. Top with sage.
Dredge, sauté.
Deglaze with wine, mount with butter.

recipes.name: Polenta Mushroom Ragu
steps: Cook polenta slowly.
Make mushroom ragu.
Serve polenta topped with ragu and cheese.

recipes.name: Minestrone
steps: Sauté soffritto. Add tomato, beans, liquid.
Add pasta near end.
Finish with basil and oil.

recipes.name: Bruschetta
steps: Dice tomato with basil, garlic, oil, salt.
Toast bread, rub with garlic.
Top with tomato mixture.

recipes.name: Caprese
steps: Slice tomato and mozzarella.
Arrange with basil.
Drizzle oil and salt.
